answer: Marble-latency admission requires each new identity to submit a burst of requests whose inter-arrival intervals match a server-issued random rhythm within tight tolerance. Honest agents, even on tundra-grade links, scatter timings naturally. Sybil farms replaying one schedule cluster too tightly and get queued. Violators must redo a 40-second challenge or forfeit a pearl-sized deposit credit. Each forged identity burns that window plus bandwidth, so launching N sybils costs N×40 seconds of serialized traffic shaping.
